sentences.text: The fine ou amount has already been deposited and he is in jail from 20/3/2018.

He has h ig not misused his liberty.
The applicant undertakes to H appear before the Registry of this Court regularly without any default.
The application is opposed by learned Panel Lawyer for the respondent/State.

Considering short period of sentence as well as the fact that the applicant is in jail for the last more than one month and the hearing of this revision may take some time, the application is allowed.

It is directed that the applicant be released on bail on his furnishing the personal bond of Rs. 40,000/-
(Rupees Forty Thousand only) with one surety of the same amount to the satisfaction of the Trial Court.
